lines: d35: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Shanice Vargas is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d35: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d35: 🕯️ Shanice is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d35: 🕯️ Shanice Vargas is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d35: What Shanice kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d35: "Shanice's gone." Walt looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Shanice." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d35: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Jae blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Ritual & Meaning (Level 1). Marking the dead matters. Even without religion, ritual holds grief.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d35: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d35: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Shanice Vargas, 35 days. The mantle passes to Jae DeLuca.
d35: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Jae DeLuca, 22 — a tattoo artist. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Lucky Rock, Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, War Cry.
d35: The village's quarrel was with Shanice — and Shanice is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d35: At the grave, Walt, Hua, Bernadette and 3 more speak for Jae — "Shanice trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d35: The fire knew Jae before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
